name: browser-use
headline: Legal Assistant Skills - Automate Legal Work
short_description: AI assistant skills for legal work. Automates contract review, comment annotations, and integrates with Claude Code, Codex, and other platforms. Benefits legal teams by speeding up document processing and reducing manual review time.
author: zh-xx

sections.overview:
Legal Assistant Skills is a repository of eight specialized AI skills designed for legal professionals using Claude Code, Cursor, and similar platforms. The collection includes contract review with structured annotations, contract generation from transaction details, legal text conversion to Markdown, advertising compliance audits, food label compliance checks, legal risk visualization, job search assistance for legal roles, and legal architecture diagramming. Each skill applies domain-specific workflows—such as four-layer contract review models or multi-stage compliance pipelines—to reduce manual processing time and provide structured analysis. Legal teams use these skills to accelerate document review, ensure regulatory compliance, identify legal risks, and generate professional outputs in standardized formats.
Review contracts with annotated risk questions without modifying original text
Generate compliant contracts from transaction details and party stance
Convert legal statutes and regulations into structured Markdown format
Audit advertising copy and creative assets for legal compliance
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/zh-xx/legal-assistant-skills`
sections.usage:
```
Review the following contract for [COMPANY] and highlight any clauses that may pose legal risks. Focus on [INDUSTRY]-specific regulations and flag any non-compliant sections. Annotate with suggested revisions and provide a summary of key findings. Use the following data: [DATA].
```
